summary: ansible-galaxy role init role_name scaffolds a role with README, defaults, files, handlers, meta, tasks, templates, tests and vars; a role repo's root should be the role directory.
questions: How do I create the skeleton for a new role?
What directories does ansible-galaxy role init create?
What should the repository root be for a role?

answer_card.title: Scaffold a new role
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-galaxy role init role_name
```
Creates:
```text
role_name/
  README.md
  defaults/main.yml   files/   handlers/main.yml
  meta/main.yml       tasks/main.yml   templates/
  tests/inventory  tests/test.yml   vars/main.yml
```
If the role gets its own repository, make `role_name` the repo root.
